description: The image shows a multi-pane desktop environment with what appears to be an Extended Logic application visible in the title bar. The left side displays a dark terminal/console window showing "CECL" with some processing output including "PRE quarters" and "POST quarters" with dates (2021-2a22, 2022-3a22-4a22, etc.) and a completion message stating "Total processed this time - 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 quarters." The center/right portion shows a data table or spreadsheet view with multiple columns containing file paths and data references (visible text includes paths like "data_src_Final_hist_grid_working_revised"). A code editor or file browser panel on the far right shows what appears to be sample tables code with references to "SAMPLE_TABLES AND BALANCE TABLES." The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing the time is 3:58 AM.

The screenshot shows DBeaver (a database management application) with a SQL query editor in the left panel containing a SELECT statement with JOIN operations querying table metadata (table_name, table_size, table_schema, time_created). A terminal window is overlaid on the right side showing a script execution output with bullet points listing "2021-2q22 - 2 quarters", "2022 through 2q23 Exclusive", and other date range calculations, with a yellow/green summary line at the bottom reading "Total processed this time - 2 PRE - 14 POST - 16 quarters". The user appears to be running a data processing script while referencing or writing SQL queries, with the Windows taskbar visible at the bottom showing it's running on Windows.

The image shows DBeaver database IDE with a SQL query editor in the left portion containing a SELECT statement joining tables (visible code includes "FROM items s LEFT JOIN source s" and column selections like "table_size, table_name, table_rows, time_created"). A terminal/console window is overlaid on the right side showing a Python script execution with output labeled "Breakdown:" displaying "PRE queries:" and "POST queries:" statistics, followed by date-based entries (2022-Jul2-Jul2 through Aug2, 2021-Aug2-Aug2) and a summary line reading "Total processed this time - 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries." The user appears to be running a database migration or query processing script while referencing the SQL query structure. The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing various application icons.

The screenshot shows Extended Logic application (visible in the red title bar at top-left) with a dark-themed code editor on the left side containing SQL code with syntax highlighting (yellow, green, and pink text) including SELECT statements and table references. On the right side, there's a black terminal/console window displaying command output with text showing "Resolution:" followed by bullet points including "PRE query," "POST query 3a22 (through 3p23 Exclusive)," date entries like "2022-3q22-4q22 - 3" and "2023-2q23-4q23 - 1," and a summary line "Total processed this time - 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries." The user appears to be reviewing or executing SQL queries and examining the results in the terminal output. The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing various application icons including Chrome, File Explorer, and other system tray items.

The screen shows DBeaver database IDE (visible in window title "DBeaver") with a SQL query editor on the left side displaying a SELECT query that joins tables (`FROM time_s LEFT JOIN source s ON s.table_name = s.table_name`) with columns including `table_size`, `table_name`, `time_created`, and filtering with `WHERE table_name = 'en1_105_final_[1:4]pyr[0:2]'`. On the right side, there's a dark terminal/console window showing execution output with statistics: "Total processed this time: 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries" along with timing information and a results table. The user appears to be reviewing query execution results after running a database operation.
